name: call-me-back
description: Resume this agent session on a signal instead of clock polling. Use when you need to (1) wait for a process this session started to finish — "끝나면 깨워줘", "완료되면 알려줘", "run in background and call me back"; (2) react to events that arrive from outside — "X가 오면 Y 해줘", "새 이벤트가 생기면 처리해줘", "when a new one comes in, handle it" — by wiring a hook/webhook/watcher that POSTs to $LIBRAGENT_WAKE_URL. Arriving events → this skill; checking on a time interval → loop. NEVER for pure time reminders or cron ("5분 뒤", "매일 9시") — use loop (session) or schedule (global). "me" means this agent session, not a phone call.
